info.name: Get all reactions to a cast

params.name: target_fid
params.description: The FID of the cast's creator

params.name: target_hash
params.description: The hash of the cast

params.name: reaction_type
params.description: The type of reaction, either as a numerical enum value or string representation

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of messages to return in a single response

params.name: reverse
params.description: Reverse the sort order, returning latest messages first

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The page token returned by the previous query, to fetch the next page. If this parameter is empty, fetch the first page
